reason: The bloodrager's draconic bloodlines each grant their own "Breath Weapon" at level 8 (BloodragerDragonBrassBloodline and its second-bloodline copy), as do the Primalist's retained bloodline powers and, for every colour but copper, the bloodline Mixed Bloodline picks each day; the colours share the family name "Draconic". Each is qualified as the bloodrager's, by its dragon's colour.
